s1.syndrome_frame: Acute chest pain with pleuritic and intermittent characteristics, associated with diaphoresis and elevated troponin levels, in a young adult with recent onset of systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain
No family history of cardiovascular disease
Low mean corpuscular volume of 75 fL
C-reactive protein of 59 mg/L rising to 173 mg/L
Normal left ventricular size on echocardiography
Normal right ventricle without pericardial effusion
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging

shortlist.label: Myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated troponin levels, extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, and recent onset of systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Acute coronary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated troponin levels, borderline low systolic function, and chest pain characteristics

shortlist.label: Inflammatory bowel disease-associated cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Recent diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and cardiac involvement suggested by elevated troponin and abnormal cardiac magnetic resonance imaging

shortlist.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging and recent onset of systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Pleuritic chest pain, diaphoresis, and elevated C-reactive protein levels

rule_in.why: sharp central chest pain is characteristic of pericarditis

rule_out.why: chest pain location and characteristics are not typical

trace.fact: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward

rule_in.why: it typically improves with sitting forward and worsens with lying down, but the specific worsening with sitting forward is less common and this fact is most compatible with pericarditis relative to the other options
it is most directly associated with elevated troponin levels

rule_out.why: it is less directly associated with elevated troponin

rule_in.why: clubbing is more common in chronic conditions

rule_out.why: clubbing is not specific to any candidate

trace.fact: Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging

rule_in.why: it is most associated with patchy late gadolinium enhancement

rule_out.why: it is less commonly associated with cardiac magnetic resonance imaging findings

trace.fact: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain

rule_in.why: sharp, central chest pain is characteristic of pericarditis

rule_out.why: chest pain location and character are not typical

rule_in.why: it classically presents with sharp chest pain that worsens with movement or sitting forward

rule_out.why: Pericarditis pain is typically worsened by lying down and improved by sitting forward
